{{Quote|Hey&mdash;is that a PV-One-Eight-Seven holographic display unit?|Han Solo|<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
The '''PV 187 Holographic display''' was a state-of-the-art unit capable of receiving transmissions.<ref name="Omen" /> 

In [[43 ABY]], the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] featured an asylum block that contained specialized cells for prisoners. Each cell included flowform couches, tables, chairs, and PV 187 display units to keep the prisoners occupied. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seff Hellin]] was imprisoned in one such cell while suffering from a case of [[Force psychosis]].<ref name="Omen" />
